name: pwa-preview
description: Deploy and manage temporary HTTPS previews of pre-built static web applications and PWAs.

interface.longDescription: Publish already-built static web applications and PWAs to temporary HTTPS preview URLs. Create, inspect, update, extend, and delete previews without executing application build code.
defaultPrompt: Publish this built static web app as a temporary preview.
Update my existing preview with the latest build.
Show me my active PWA previews.
